artist: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio / Goddard Conceptual Image Lab
caption: NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory, in an artist's concept released in 2025. Launched in 2004, it has no propulsion and has been sinking through the upper atmosphere for years.
A Pegasus XL rocket drops away from the L-1011 'Stargazer' aircraft and ignites. LINK launched the same way on July 3, 2026 — the last planned flight of a Pegasus.
A reaction wheel. LINK carried three. Two of them died from an electrical fault, and that — not the robotics — is what ended the rescue.

artist: NASA E/PO, Sonoma State University / Aurore Simonnet
caption: A model of the Swift spacecraft. No docking port, no grapple fixtures, and no close-out photographs of its underside. The repair crew had to find something to hold onto.
